steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: An exoplanet is a planet orbiting a star other than the Sun; over 5,500 have been confirmed | Key Fact: The transit method detects exoplanets by measuring the dip in a star's brightness as a planet passes in front | Key Fact: The radial velocity (Doppler) method detects the wobble of a star caused by an orbiting planet | Key Fact: The habitable zone (Goldilocks zone) is the region around a star where liquid water could exist on a planet's surface

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from exoplanets &amp; astrobiology, and one past-paper question.
